heroDescription: Make every choice easier. Create an account to start your digital shopping journey.
footerMotto: CHOOSE WITH CONFIDENCE. START WITH EASE.
methodHint: Select where to receive your 6-digit code.
codeSent: If the account and method are eligible, a code has been sent. Check your messages.
codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code, valid for 5 minutes.
loginSubtitle: Sign in to continue your Klikchart experience.
registerSubtitle1: Start with a username and email address.
registerSubtitle2: Finish setting up your account security.
newPasswordSubtitle: Use a fresh password to secure your account.
forgotSubtitle: Enter your registered email, then verify via OTP.
noMethod: No OTP delivery method is configured. Contact the administrator.
successMessage: Your Klikchart account is now successfully created and verified. You can sign in with your registered account.
resetSuccess: Your password was updated. Please sign in again.
infoAbout: Klikchart provides account management for digital shopping services. Catalog, cart, and checkout features are planned separately.
helpBody: Register with a username, email, WhatsApp number, and password. Verify using a code sent through an available channel. Use account recovery if you forget your password.
privacyBody: Klikchart uses HttpOnly session cookies. Supabase Auth handles passwords. Your email is remembered locally only if you choose it. Codes expire after 5 minutes and are not included in API responses.
appSubtitle: Manage your account security and contact verification.
appNotice: Catalog, cart, and checkout are not available yet. Account infrastructure is ready for future development.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Please check the information you entered.
USERNAME_INVALID: Use 3–20 letters, numbers, periods (.) or underscores (_).
EMAIL_TAKEN: This email is already registered. If your signup is unfinished, use the same password to resume, or sign in if your account is active.
PHONE_INVALID: Enter a valid Indonesian WhatsApp number.
PHONE_TAKEN: This verified WhatsApp number is already in use.
PASSWORD_INVALID: Use 8–72 characters with at least one letter and one number.
IDENTIFIER_REQUIRED: Enter an email address or username.
ACCOUNT_UNVERIFIED: This account hasn't been verified. Complete registration first.
OTP_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new one.
OTP_USED: This code has already been used. Request a new one.
OTP_LOCKED: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
FLOW_EXPIRED: Your verification session has expired. Start again.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again later.
RESEND_WAIT: Wait until the countdown is over.
CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE: This verification channel is unavailable for your account.
DELIVERY_FAILED: We couldn't send the code. Try again later.
VERIFICATION_NOT_SAVED: Verification couldn't be saved. Try again.
SERVER_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server isn't configured yet. Contact an administrator.
AUTH_PROVIDER_ERROR: The authentication service is temporarily unavailable.
INTERNAL_ERROR: A server error occurred. Please try again.
firstWAHint: This number will be verified after a valid OTP.

accountWAUnavailable: WhatsApp OTP is unavailable. Contact the service administrator.
accountWANoPhone: No WhatsApp number is saved on this account.
accountWASubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code sent to the number on your account.
resetEmailConfirm: An unverified WhatsApp number requires an additional code sent to your account email. Enter the 6-digit email code.
registrationStepReview: Please review the previous step. Correct the highlighted fields, then continue.
registrationResumed: We found your unfinished registration. Choose the saved Email or WhatsApp contact to continue OTP verification. Your existing account details were not changed.
firstEmailHint: This email will be verified after a valid OTP.
methodUnavailable: Not available yet. Contact the administrator.
bothMethodsNote: Choose Email or WhatsApp. An unverified contact becomes verified when its OTP succeeds.

SMTP_AUTH_FAILED: SMTP login was rejected. Check the sender address and Gmail App Password.
SMTP_CONNECTION_FAILED: Could not connect to SMTP. Check connectivity, firewall, or email port.
SMTP_TLS_FAILED: SMTP TLS negotiation failed. Try port 587 with secure=false or port 465 with secure=true.
SMTP_REJECTED: The email server rejected the recipient or message. Verify the account email address.
emailInboxHint: Email OTP requested. Check Inbox, Spam, and Promotions at
emailSendAccepted: The sending server accepted the OTP request. Check Inbox, Spam, or Promotions; inbox delivery is not guaranteed.
